Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use an active tracked part, part A, that was at the test location before this release was installed and that no other test needs.
    • How to do it: On this QA site the parts that came with its data and were never changed have no clock icon at the left of their row on the Inventory list; for example 3030 Long Stroke Brake Chamber (W3030LS), which has stock and Min 10 and Max 50, and 3030 Standard Brake Chamber, 13.25" Rod (W3030T). Use W3030T as part A.
  • Use a date before the release, date A, on which the Inventory Value report lists part A.
    • How to do it: Click Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value under PARTS; click the As of: date and pick a date before this release.
  • Write down part A's Qty and Total Cost on the Inventory Value report for date A.
    • How to do it: On that report click Search, type W3030T and note its Qty and Total Cost.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
